name: Streets of New York
summary:
New York City, 1981. As night falls, the streets transform into a battleground where gangs fight for respect, survival, and dominance. In Streets of New York, you are part of a tight-knit gang with one mission: make it through hostile territory and return to your home turf. Inspired by the raw intensity of The Warriors, this game plunges you into a relentless journey across New York’s gritty, neon-lit boroughs, where danger lurks around every corner.
